emphasis_points: Convey commercial-grade durability and professional aesthetic presence for executive suites and home work suites.
Detail executive desk wire concealment grommets, modesty panels, locking pedestal drawers, and expansive work zones.
Highlight high-back executive seating with premium bonded leather or executive mesh, integrated headrests, and multi-synchro tilt mechanisms.
avoid_list: Do not use generic corporate clichés ('synergy', 'power moves', 'disruptive boardroom authority').
Do not assume central lock mechanisms secure all drawers unless confirmed in source attributes.
Do not claim BIFMA commercial certification unless specifically verified in product specifications.
tone_notes: Professional, commanding, and enduring, delivering executive clarity, durable daily ergonomics, and organized workflow.
